The '''Department of History and Culture''' was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Veron Minor|Veron]], the [[Gazar]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. They confiscated any artifacts found by tourists on the [[Broken Trees Islands]], although the tourists in question were well compensated for their discoveries.
